errors.evidence: The vertical axis scale extends above 0.8, as several bars have values greater than 0.8 (e.g., STS Corr. for Supervised_SimCSE and 2-Tier SimCSE). The description incorrectly states the maximum value displayed on the axis is 0.8.

errors.text_span: The 'Single-task_baseline' model exhibits the shortest bars
errors.evidence: This is an incorrect generalization. While the STS Correlation bar for this model is the shortest on the entire chart (approx. 0.49), its Paraphrase Accuracy bar is the tallest among all Paraphrase Accuracy bars (approx. 0.79).
The STS Correlation (pink bar) for the 'Single-task_baseline' model is clearly below the 0.5 line, at approximately 0.49. The stated value of 0.58 is a significant overestimation.
The Paraphrase Accuracy (blue bar) for the 'Single-task_baseline' model is very close to the 0.8 line, at approximately 0.79. The stated value of 0.75 is a significant underestimation.

errors.text_span: The '2-Tier SimCSE' model has the tallest bars
errors.evidence: This is an incorrect generalization. While the STS Correlation bar for this model is one of the two tallest on the chart (approx. 0.82), its Sentiment Accuracy bar is one of the shortest (approx. 0.49).
The Sentiment Accuracy (yellow bar) for the '2-Tier SimCSE' model is just below the 0.5 line, at approximately 0.49. The stated value of 0.79 is a massive overestimation.
The STS Correlation (pink bar) for the '2-Tier SimCSE' model is visibly above the 0.8 line, at approximately 0.82. The stated value of 0.78 is an underestimation.
